what.text: This page follows refugees from Ukraine living in North Macedonia, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 20741 Ukrainian refugees in North Macedonia, 0.4% of all refugees from Ukraine.
The largest numbers of Ukrainian refugees live in Germany, Poland, Czechia and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Russia and Ukraine from 2022 to 2025, at war level in every year.
Before that, it records armed conflict over Novorossiya territory in Ukraine from 2017 to 2022, with the DPR and the LPR.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2022 at 6816 refugees.
The figure was at its highest at the end of 2024 and 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in North Macedonia.
These are year-end totals for North Macedonia only, reported to UNHCR.
